description: Renovate is this repo's only dependency bot; Dependabot security updates are turned off in Settings (Dependabot alerts stay on, Renovate reads them).

Direct Go modules and docs/package.json are extracted directly. Vulnerable indirect Go modules come from security:gomodIndirectSecurityUpdates in the shared preset, and lockfile-only npm packages in docs/ from the preset's weekly lockFileMaintenance.

packageRules.description: Docs site is not shipped with the operator; group its churn into one PR.
Kubernetes libraries must version in lockstep.
go-git is core to cloning; e2e does not run on PRs, so review these deliberately and never automerge.
